data.desc: Orthofix is a global medical technology company dedicated to advancing healing and restoring mobility for patients with complex musculoskeletal conditions. Headquartered in Lewisville, Texas, the Company offers a differentiated portfolio of spinal implants, therapeutic solutions, limb reconstruction systems, biologics and enabling technologies, including the 7D FLASH Navigation System. Orthofix's technology-enabled solutions are designed to support surgeons across the continuum of care and improve outcomes for patients.
